bleed.limitations: Does not generate artwork bleed; box rewrite only.
bleed.measures: Whether required page bleed boxes exist and meet amount_pt.

parameters.meaning: Bleed or off-page length in points; 9 pt is one eighth of an inch.
Slack allowed before a measured box is called a mismatch.

severity.condition: a page BleedBox is missing or meets amount_pt minus tolerance_pt on fewer than four edges. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

color-inventory.limitations: Probe DPI bounds small tints; not a GWG ink-name dictionary.

parameters.meaning: Resolution of the page probe that bounds which tints and rich-black areas are inventoried.
Minimum process-black percentage for a region to count as rich black.
Inspection scope; a check-level object can only narrow the profile scope.

severity.condition: a spot colour is inventoried on the page. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.
an output separation, spot or process, is inventoried. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.
a rich-black region is inventoried above rich_black_k_percent. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

color-mode.limitations: Does not convert color; ICC-based spaces are classified by the alternate.
color-mode.measures: Whether page color spaces are in the allowed list.

parameters.meaning: Color modes that may be painted; an empty list makes the check return without inspecting.
parameters.range: non-empty subset of CMYK|RGB|Grayscale; required for color-mode

parameters.meaning: Inspection scope; a check-level object can only narrow the profile scope.

severity.condition: a page paints at least one color space outside the allowed list. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

conformance-claims.limitations: Does not produce those files and does not evaluate their external-resource or n-colorant output-intent rules. A declared level is reported unsupported. PDF/VT is a separate gap.
conformance-claims.measures: Whether the document declares PDF/X-5n, PDF/X-5g, or PDF/A-3, which Loop does not validate.

severity.condition: the document declares pdfx-5n, pdfx-5g, or pdfa-3. The finding stays a warning so it is not a content-defect error; the check status is unsupported and the run is incomplete.
catalog metadata is present but cannot be decoded, and no level was declared in the document info keys. The check status is not_inspected.

content-bleed.limitations: Raster confirm is opt-in; vector-only bounds can miss sparse marks.
content-bleed.measures: Whether painted content reaches the requested bleed margin.

parameters.meaning: Bleed or off-page length in points; 9 pt is one eighth of an inch.
Resolution of the bleed-margin strip raster; the confirm pass only runs when raster_confirm is true.
Pixel channel value that counts as ink in the strip raster.
Fraction of strip coverage that still counts as white.
Opt in to the strip raster confirm pass instead of the fast vector bounds pass.

severity.condition: the fast bounds pass finds a bleed edge with no painted content. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

raster_confirm is true and a bleed edge strip carries no pixel above probe_threshold. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.
always info: the page has a bleed gap and is a candidate for the add-bleed fixup.

dieline.measures: Alias of processing-steps for cutting-die workflows.

parameters.meaning: When true, a cutting-die processing step must exist.
Processing step types that must each be detected.
parameters.range: normalized ISO 19593-1 step names, for example cutting-die

severity.condition: required is true and neither an ISO 19593-1 cutting-die OCG nor a legacy dieline spot colour was detected. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.
a required_types entry has no matching detected processing step. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.
a detected dieline step is still marked printable (shouldPrint). The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

embedded-fonts.limitations: Does not subset or repair; descriptor-less fonts are reported, not fixed.

parameters.meaning: Inspection scope; a check-level object can only narrow the profile scope.

severity.condition: a used font has no font descriptor or is not embedded on the page that uses it. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

font-integrity.measures: Embedded font bytes that fail to parse or cmap.

severity.condition: an embedded font program fails to parse or its cmap cannot be read; a complete inspection keeps the check severity, an incomplete one is forced to error

hidden-layers.limitations: Does not enumerate every OCMD combination.
hidden-layers.measures: Optional content groups that hide print content.

parameters.meaning: Off-page tolerance in points added around the effective page box by the shared hidden-content scan; it only widens the off-page test.

severity.condition: an optional-content group referenced by print content is not printable by default. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

image-resolution.limitations: Masks and patterns can be under-counted.

parameters.meaning: Minimum effective image resolution; image-resolution rejects 0 or a negative value.
Inspection scope; a check-level object can only narrow the profile scope.

severity.condition: an image's effective DPI is below min_dpi. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

ink-coverage.limitations: Raster probe; not a plate-ready separation TAC.

parameters.meaning: Maximum total area coverage percentage; the profile must supply it because 0 is not usable.
Resolution of the area-coverage raster.
Smallest over-limit connected region, as a percentage of the page, that is reported.
Cap on over-limit regions reported per page; 0 suppresses region findings while still inspecting.
Per-page pixel budget; exceeding it reports the page as incomplete instead of clean.
Production region analysed for total area coverage; bleed falls back to trim, crop, then media.
Inspection scope; a check-level object can only narrow the profile scope.

severity.condition: a connected region exceeds max_ink_pct over more than min_region_area_pct of the page. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.
the page raster exceeded max_raster_pixels, was unavailable, or reported non-exact fidelity, so the page is reported incomplete rather than clean.

invisible-content.limitations: Not a full GWG hidden-content suite.
invisible-content.measures: Content marked invisible or outside view.

parameters.meaning: Off-page tolerance in points added around the effective page box by the shared hidden-content scan; it only widens the off-page test.

severity.condition: the page paints with text render mode 3, or a path is painted at zero fill/stroke alpha. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

obscured-content.limitations: Heuristic; not a RIP occlusion model.

parameters.meaning: Off-page tolerance in points added around the effective page box by the shared hidden-content scan; it only widens the off-page test.

severity.condition: an earlier painted bounds is fully covered by later opaque paint; the scan is heuristic, so it is downgraded to info whenever the profile severity is error and otherwise keeps the profile severity.

off-page-content.limitations: Clipping can hide false positives and false negatives.
off-page-content.measures: Content whose bounds fall outside the page.

parameters.meaning: Off-page tolerance in points added around the effective page box by the shared hidden-content scan; it only widens the off-page test.

severity.condition: a painted mark's bounds do not intersect the effective page box widened by amount_pt. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

output-intent.measures: Output intent presence, subtype, identifier, and ICC payload.

parameters.meaning: When true, at least one output intent must be present.
Color spaces the embedded ICC profile may resolve to (output-intent); optional.
Allow-list of output-condition identifiers; optional.
Allow-list of output-intent subtypes; optional.
Allow-list of decoded ICC payload digests; optional.
Require a decodable /DestOutputProfile ICC stream.
When false, more than one valid applicable output intent is a finding.

severity.condition: the catalog /OutputIntents array holds a non-dictionary or unresolved entry. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.
no output intent exists and required is true. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.
an intent subtype is not in allowed_subtypes. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

an intent has no identifier, or its identifier is not in allowed_identifiers. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

/DestOutputProfile is absent or not a stream while require_embedded_profile is true. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

the ICC payload cannot be decoded, is not a valid ICC profile, or uses an unsupported color space. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.
the ICC payload digest is not in allowed_profile_sha256. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

the declared ProfileCS disagrees with the embedded ICC color space, or that space is not in allowed. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

more than one valid applicable intent exists while allow_multiple is false. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.
more than one valid intent resolves to conflicting color spaces. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

parameters.meaning: Expected width in points; with expected_height_pt it arms the size comparison (hasExpectedSize).
Expected height in points; with expected_width_pt it arms the size comparison (hasExpectedSize).
Slack allowed before a measured box is called a mismatch.

severity.condition: expected_width_pt and expected_height_pt are both set and the MediaBox misses them by more than tolerance_pt. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

processing-steps.measures: ISO 19593-1 processing-step presence such as cutting-die.

parameters.meaning: When true, a cutting-die processing step must exist.
Processing step types that must each be detected.
parameters.range: normalized ISO 19593-1 step names, for example cutting-die

severity.condition: required is true and neither an ISO 19593-1 cutting-die OCG nor a legacy dieline spot colour was detected. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.
a required_types entry has no matching detected processing step. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.
a detected dieline step is still marked printable (shouldPrint). The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

thin-parts.limitations: Raster budget can skip a page as incomplete rather than pass.
thin-parts.measures: Thin filled parts and optional clipped/negative/annotation classes.

parameters.meaning: Minimum painted stroke or filled-part width in points.
Declared widths at or below this value are hairlines.
Object classes inspected; clipped parts, negative space, and annotation appearances are opt-in.
Per-class severity override; an absent class uses the check severity.
parameters.range: keys are thin-parts classes, values are error|warning|info

parameters.meaning: Raster resolution used to measure a candidate part, which also sets the measurement precision 72/probe_dpi.
Per-page mask pixel budget; exceeding it reports the page as incomplete rather than clean.

severity.condition: an inspected stroke-like part measures below min_effective_width_pt; severity_by_class['thin-stroke'] replaces the check severity when set.
a filled part measures below min_effective_width_pt; severity_by_class['thin-fill'] replaces the check severity when set.
a clipped filled part measures below min_effective_width_pt and the class is opted in.
annotation appearance geometry measures below min_effective_width_pt and the class is opted in.
the union of fill paths leaves a channel narrower than min_effective_width_pt and the class is opted in.
a measurement lands within one raster pixel of min_effective_width_pt, so the class is reported incomplete instead of clean.

thin-strokes.limitations: Effective width after CTM; does not inspect filled parts.

parameters.meaning: Minimum painted stroke width in points measured after the CTM.
Declared widths at or below this value are hairlines.
Severity override for hairline-stroke findings; empty falls back to the check severity.
Severity override for thin-stroke findings; empty falls back to the check severity.
Inspection scope; a check-level object can only narrow the profile scope.

severity.condition: a stroke is a hairline, meaning its declared width is at or below zero_width_epsilon_pt; hairline_severity replaces the check severity when set.
a stroke's effective width after the CTM is below min_effective_width_pt; thin_stroke_severity replaces the check severity when set.

transparency-risk.limitations: Does not flatten; does not simulate overprint+transparency interaction as a RIP.
transparency-risk.measures: Live transparency blend modes and blend-space mismatches.

parameters.meaning: Inspection scope; a check-level object can only narrow the profile scope.

severity.condition: a page has live transparency whose blend-mode configuration list is non-empty. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.
a page records one or more transparency blend-space mismatches. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

trim.limitations: Does not invent a trim from artwork.
trim.measures: Trim box presence and optional expected size.

parameters.meaning: Expected width in points; with expected_height_pt it arms the size comparison (hasExpectedSize).
Expected height in points; with expected_width_pt it arms the size comparison (hasExpectedSize).
Slack allowed before a measured box is called a mismatch.

severity.condition: expected_width_pt and expected_height_pt are both set and the TrimBox (trim, then crop, then media fallback) misses them by more than tolerance_pt. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

white-overprint.limitations: Page-view overprint is not the measurement renderer; Output Preview / transparency renderer is.
white-overprint.measures: White/knockout overprint flags on fills and strokes.

parameters.meaning: Inspection scope; a check-level object can only narrow the profile scope.

severity.condition: a page paints white or near-white content with overprint set. The profile's check severity (error|warning|info, default error) replaces it and warning/info route the finding to warnings.

claim: Loop does not claim formal GWG conformance. For sheetfed-offset and packaging, no GWG 2022/2024 certificate requirements are evaluated; clean results cover only the listed checks. Coverage is measured against GWG process families and PDF/X.
not_covered: Formal GWG 2022/2024 sheetfed or packaging conformance certificates
PDF/VT variable-data streams are neither understood, validated, nor preserved
DeviceN ink-limit per named colorant beyond inventory
